case.amplicon_range_bp: empty site 134 bp / filled site 432 bp (delta 298 bp)
case.caveats: Dimorphic locus. Cited accession (BAC RP11-134P3, chromosome 12, 171,437 bp) carries the FILLED allele; expect 432 bp. The 134 bp empty allele is not in this accession. No degenerate bases; no junction-spanning primer. Verified by exact-string in-silico PCR: exactly one product, plus strand, 432 bp, containing the Ye-diagnostic 25-mer and canonical Alu motifs. Smallest filled product in the set. Uniqueness checked within the cited accession only. Annealing temperature 55 C.
case.citation: Salem AH, Ray DA, Hedges DJ, Jurka J, Batzer MA. Analysis of the human Alu Ye lineage. BMC Evolutionary Biology 2005;5:18. doi:10.1186/1471-2148-5-18. PMID 15725352; PMCID PMC554112.
case.element: Alu Ye5 (SINE, non-LTR); Alu Ye lineage insertion polymorphism
case.loci_justification: The pair flanks one locus on the cited template: a single insertion site, a single excision site, or a single transcript. A second product on this template would be an off-target prediction.
case.name: Alu Ye5AH13 insertion-site PCR (chr12)
case.where_in_paper: Additional File 2, captioned "Supplemental Table. Alu Ye elements, Genbank numbers, PCR primers, annealing temperature, primate diversity, location and amplicon sizes." Ye5AH13 row; the table's Chr. Loc. value (12) agrees with the accession header.
case.worked_prediction_note: The entry records a worked prediction — a coordinate range, an in-silico check, or a sequence-derived length — so the expected answer was written down before the engine ran. The published size remains external, but this case was not scored blind.
